title: Nonius Marcellus, De compendiosa doctrina / Ноний Марцелл, «Сокращённое учение»
author: Nonius Marcellus
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Ноний Марцелл': section '== Издания ==' lists only Pomponius Laetus, Quicherat 1871, Müller 1888 and Lindsay 1903. No translations are listed.
en_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Ноний Марцелл': section '== Издания ==' lists only Pomponius Laetus, Quicherat 1871, Müller 1888 and Lindsay 1903. No translations are listed.
value: The main quarry for Republican Latin fragments: Lucilius, Varro's Menippeans, Accius, Pacuvius, Sallust's Histories. It meets the 'no translation in any language' ideal. The Lindsay 1903 Teubner edition is public domain. A single book (e.g. Book IV) is a manageable unit.
